comments.author: @KeithMercer-q6g
comments.text: The thought of a passing stranger being invited to sit with a family really draws me in. I’d love to hear what that evening pause means to the people who keep it.

replies.author: @ThePlanetJournalGlobe
replies.text: It is truly heartwarming to see how such a simple, shared moment of stillness can foster such deep connection and hospitality toward strangers!
